Gam model me yenyo

Tii ki Wi-Fi ka itwero: fayil acel me %1$d MB, ma kigolo wang acel keken. Yenyo nying ki lok tiyo cut. Yenyo ki te lok bedo maber kun %2$s tye ka kwano fayil megi, dok bedo maber loyo inge dyewor acel i caja.

Yenyo maber loyo i leb ducu, ki lok ma tye i vidiyo ki kwena me dwon.

Yenyo i leb Munu bedo maber calo nining; yenyo cal i Luganda ki Swahili nok; pe tye ki lok ma tye i vidiyo onyo kwena me dwon. Itwero medo ka dong i ngeye.

Pack me model megi
Itye ki pack me Gwok data. Yenyo i leb Munu bedo maber calo nining; yenyo cal i Luganda ki Swahili nok, dok vidiyo ki kwena me dwon pe kikwano pi lok.
Itye ki pack me Standard: yenyo maber loyo i leb ducu, ki lok ma tye i vidiyo ki kwena me dwon.

Medo pack me Standard bimiyo %1$s kwano fayil megi odoco ki model ma ber loyo. Kwan me fayil megi pe bal: yenyo ki nying fayil ki nongo cal ki neno me oyotoyot bimede ki tic kare meno. Lok ma tye i waraga ki cal me wang cim, ki yenyo ki tamme, bidok ka kikwano fayil acel acel, ber loyo ka cim tye ka caji.
Gam pack me Standard (%1$d MB)

Pack me Standard dong kiketo. Lor %1$s ci yab odoco wek cako tic kwede. Ci bikwano fayil megi odoco ki model ma ber loyo. Nying fayil ki yenyo cal oyot bimede ki tic kare meno; lok ma tye i waraga ki cal me wang cim bidok ka kikwano fayil.
